youtube_description:
Dr. ‘Desh’ Deshpande, the founder of Deshpande Foundation, warmly welcomes you to Development Dialogue 2019 at the Hubballi Sandbox. The theme this year is ‘Reimagining Impact ’. Development Dialogue is an international social entrepreneurship ecosystem conference hosted in Hubballi, Karnataka by Deshpande Foundation India.
 Learn more
 http://www.developmentdialogue.org/
 http://www.deshpandefoundationindia.org/

 Register for Development Dialogue 2019
 http://www.developmentdialogue.org/dd-registration

Development Dialogue is attended by global visionaries, impact investors, representatives from non-profits and for-profits as well as people from local communities. The conference brings stakeholders from around the world to the Hubballi Sandbox to share proven models, innovations, transforming perspectives, and to exchange ideas about what makes the most impactful and lasting change. 

Write to ddhubli@dfmail.org if you wish to join the collaborative team and help curate the event Help us spread the word about Sandbox and Development Dialogue using #SandboxDD Connect with us
